parts.text: Different 3 by 3 magic squares are made using the first nine terms of a sequence. The first term of the sequence is 2. The n th term of the sequence is n 3 1 - . Find six of these magic squares. Use the method of Question 4 and reflection to help you. [5]

content.tex: Different 3 by 3 magic squares are made using the first nine terms of a sequence. The first term of the sequence is 2. The \(n\) th term of the sequence is \(3n-1\) .
Find six of these magic squares. Use the method of Question 4 and reflection to help you.
